jsonLd.name: Jawline Contouring in Miami
jsonLd.description: Non-surgical jawline contouring at Real Aesthetic Medical Spa in Miami uses hyaluronic acid filler or Radiesse along the mandibular border — and, when appropriate, masseter neuromodulator — to define the lower face without surgery, supervised by Ronal Perdomo Lugo, APRN, FNP-C.

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The jawline contouring we offer at Real Aesthetic is non-surgical and works on the soft tissues that drape the mandible. Surgical jaw contouring — osteotomy, genioplasty, mandibular angle reduction — is performed by a maxillofacial surgeon and reshapes bone. Injectables refine and define the existing jaw; they do not modify the skeleton.

mainEntity.name: HA filler or Radiesse — which is better for the jaw?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on goals and anatomy. HA is softer and reversible, ideal for patients who want adjustability and a more refined feel. Radiesse is firmer and more structural, biostimulates collagen, and is preferred when stronger projection along the bony border is the priority. Ronal Perdomo Lugo, APRN, FNP-C recommends the right option after assessing your jaw.

mainEntity.name: Are male and female jawlines treated differently?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Male jaws typically benefit from a more angular, anteriorly projected angle and stronger ramus support, with a flat-bottom mandibular border. Female jaws are usually shaped towards a softer, slightly tapered line with refined projection. We use your bone structure as the reference rather than a generic template.

blocks.title: What it does for you
list: Sharpens the mandibular line and improves the visual transition between face and neck.
Defines the gonial angle (jaw angle) when projection is needed for structural support.
Softens the appearance of an enlarged masseter when combined with neuromodulator.
Creates a more balanced lower-face frame for chin, lips, and neck features.
Adapts to gender-specific aesthetic goals: more angular and projected for male patients, more refined and tapered for female patients.
Performed in a single in-office session per visit — no incisions, no anesthesia beyond topical, predictable recovery.
HA versions are reversible with hyaluronidase if the patient wants to step back from a result.
